subject: Renewing my books
body: Hi, I have three books due this Friday and I won't finish them in time. Is there a way to renew them online without coming to the library? Thanks, Wing Man

subject: Opening hours during reading week
body: Hello, could you tell me what time the Main Library opens during reading week? I want to come early. Thanks.

subject: Request for a consultation on systematic review
body: Dear Librarian, I am starting a systematic review with two PhD students and would like to meet to discuss search strategies. Would sometime next week work? Best, Prof Lee

subject: Printing in colour
body: Hi, how much does it cost to print in colour at the Main Library, and how do I add money to my printing account?

subject: Cannot access journals from home
body: I am off campus and cannot open any of the journal databases. It keeps asking me to pay. What am I doing wrong?

subject: Automated: Daily circulation report
body: This is an automated message. Your scheduled report has been generated. Do not reply to this message.

subject: Fined unfairly
body: I returned my book on time and I have still been fined $200. This is completely unacceptable and I want it removed immediately. I have been a member for six years.

subject: Level 3 aircon maintenance Thursday
body: Dear colleagues, please note the air conditioning on Level 3 will be serviced on Thursday morning. Please inform desk staff. Regards, Facilities

subject: 借書問題
body: 你好，請問研究生最多可以借多少本書？借閱期限是多久？謝謝。

subject: Past exam papers
body: Hi, where can I find past examination papers for my course? I heard there is a database but I cannot find it on the website.

subject: Booking a discussion room
body: Hello, my group needs a room for a project meeting next Tuesday afternoon. How do we book one?

subject: Reference management software
body: I have collected about 200 papers for my thesis and it is becoming unmanageable. Does the library provide any software to help organise references?

subject: Book not in HKU collection
body: The book I need for my literature review is not held by HKU. Is there any way to get it from another university?

subject: 開放時間
body: 請問圖書館考試期間的開放時間是甚麼？謝謝。

subject: URGENT - thesis due tomorrow, database down
body: My thesis is due tomorrow at noon and I cannot get into Web of Science. I have been trying for two hours. Please help urgently.

subject: Question
body: Hi, I am new here. Can you help me?

subject: Available for a 30 min chat on Wednesday?
body: Hi, the Faculty would like someone from the library to talk to our new postgrads about resources. Are you free Wednesday at 3?

subject: WiFi in the library
body: Is there wireless internet in the reading areas, and how do I connect my laptop to it?

subject: Boost your library traffic 300%!!!
body: Dear Sir/Madam, our proven marketing system can transform your institution. Click here for a free consultation. Unsubscribe at any time.

subject: Someone recalled my book
body: I got an email saying my loan period has been shortened because another reader wants the book. Can they really do that? I still need it.
